conflicts.remarks_quote:
This property is valid only if [[ISwScene::BackgroundType]] is set to one of the following:

- [[swSceneBackgroundType_e]].swBackgroundType_Image

- swSceneBackgroundType_e.swBackgroundType_Graduated

- swSceneBackgroundType_e.swBackgroundType_Plain
conflicts.example_quote: Scene.BackgroundType = swSceneBackgroundType_e.swBackgroundType_UseEnvironment … Debug.Print "Keep the scene background when changing the scene? " & Scene.KeepBackground
conflicts.why: Remarks 把有效范围限定为 Image/Graduated/Plain；三份示例都先把 BackgroundType 设成 UseEnvironment（不在表内）再读该属性，两侧对有效前置的界定不能同时成立。

results.note: CSharp/VBNET 两份同型：BackgroundType=UseEnvironment 后读 KeepBackground。

conflicts.remarks_quote: Call [[IDeleteBodyFeatureData::Bodies]] to specify the bodies to keep or delete.
conflicts.example_quote: boolstatus = Part.Extension.SelectByID2("Fillet5", "SOLIDBODY", 5.92851881957586E-02, 4.09115950836281E-02, -1.97275812591329E-02, True, 0, Nothing, 0) … Set myFeature = Part.FeatureManager.InsertDeleteBody2(False)
conflicts.why: Remarks 说须调 Bodies 指定要保留/删除的体；三份示例只靠 SOLIDBODY 预选建特征，全程未调 Bodies，两种指定方式不能同时是必需。

conflicts.remarks_quote: This property is valid only if [[ISectionViewData::ShowSectionCap]] is true and [[ISectionViewData::GraphicsOnlySection]] is false.
conflicts.example_quote:
data.ShowSectionCap = True
    data.KeepCapColor = True
    data.GraphicsOnlySection = True
conflicts.why: Remarks 要求 GraphicsOnlySection 为 false；CSharp/VBNET 两份同型示例却设成 True 仍写 KeepCapColor=True，且后置条件称剖面已着色，两条不能同时成立。

results.note: Get_Sectioned_Bodies_Example_VB 用 KeepCapColor=False 且 GraphicsOnlySection=False，符合 Remarks。
